pace.definition: possession_environment = (z of home offense plays + z of away defense plays allowed + z of away offense plays + z of home defense plays allowed) / 2, on adjusted values. volatility.definition: offense_ypp_residual_sd = game-to-game spread of the offense's yards per play around what the fit expected against each opponent; its percentile is within the FBS universe. explosive_yard_share_z is the raw share standardised across FBS (not opponent-adjusted). takeaways_per_game_z and giveaways_per_game_z are RAW per-game turnover counts standardised across FBS: turnovers are regression-prone and are deliberately not opponent-adjusted.
